mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.data_scope, (r.resource_scope = 2) AS all_resources, m.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.enabled = TRUE JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.enabled = TRUE WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.id, m.id
SELECT rd.dept_id FROM sys_role_dept rd JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = rd.dept_id AND d.enabled = TRUE WHERE rd.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY rd.dept_id

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{rootId} AND enabled = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT d.id FROM sys_dept d JOIN descendants p ON d.parent_id = p.id WHERE d.enabled = TRUE ) SELECT id FROM descendants
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = FALSE, security_version = security_version + 1, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userId} AND security_version = #{version}
UPDATE sys_user SET language = #{language}, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userId}
